title: Implement deliberate multi-leader brainstorm workflow v1
acceptance_criteria: An ordinary question never creates a brainstorm; only the documented explicit start intent does
Start, continue, list/status, conclusion, and task-publication intents are documented in AGENTS.md and the brainstorm workflow
Ongoing and concluded brainstorms have separate generated indexes while record paths stay stable
Each list/status response contains a two-to-four-line state summary, stage, disagreements, and next action
A concluded brainstorm emits an unmistakable BRAINSTORM ENDED block and states that tasks were not created
Implementation tasks are published only after an explicit CREATE TASKS FROM BRAINSTORM intent
Independent positions cannot read other positions until the independent round is complete
Contributions and events are immutable, attributed, ordered, correlated, and reconstruct state in a fresh clone
Concurrent contribution claims use Git compare-and-swap and stale claimants are rejected
Legacy and preferred capability aliases normalize before HIGH-only brainstorm eligibility checks
Brainstorm commands, archive validation, summaries, state transitions, and concurrency are covered by Podman-run Go tests
Existing queue commands and tests continue to pass
validation: trigger and exact output contract tests
